topic: Changes made under an unlock do not say so
detail: Low. A change made from an unlocked terminal (SetEnforcement, outbound rules, policy apply) is recorded with callerLabel's 'operator (process N)', the same as before spaces; the record does not name the unlock (its id) or that Orch.app confirmed it. Proposed: label such changes 'operator (process N, unlock <id>)' and keep the unlock log lines with them.
